description: This Java class 'ArtifactInfoGatherer' traverses and collects artifact-related information from various widget and model components within the OFBiz framework, such as screens, forms, actions, and fields, by implementing visitor patterns.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses widget and model components to gather artifact information such as entity names, service names, screen locations, form locations, and request locations.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer.FieldInfoGatherer
classes.description: A nested class implementing ModelFieldVisitor to extract request locations from fields with hyperlinks.

methods.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gatherer with an ArtifactInfoContext.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Various overridden methods implementing the visitor pattern for different widget and model components, collecting relevant artifact info.

methods.name: visitModelForm
methods.description: Processes a ModelForm, extracting actions, auto-fields, targets, and fields to gather entity, service, and request locations.
